method.name: default-off direct hot pool prefill after one-cache init
method.description: Dirty-source probe adding GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_DIRECT_PREFILL_AFTER_CACHE=1 to try to initialize the 12288MiB gate one-cache before starting the 480-entry direct hot pool.
method.reason_not_retained: The probe did not improve token rate and still reported the 12288MiB one-cache cudaMalloc failure.

run.correctness: pass: coherent quantum-computing explanation, truncated only by n=96

decision: Reject. The intended allocation-order guard did not preserve the main gate one-cache in the multithreaded first-call path, and performance remained far below the first320 SOTA.
next: A future allocation-order fix must serialize first-call one-cache initialization before any direct hot-pool initialization across all worker threads, or reserve/cache-budget memory explicitly. Do not keep this dirty implementation.
